items.prompt: The staging area (index) is where you…
choices: Prepare changes for the next commit
items.explain: git add copies changes from the working tree into the staging area for the next commit.
HEAD is the current commit tip — the durable snapshot you already recorded.

items.prompt: Saving a file in your editor automatically creates a Git commit.
items.explain: Editor save updates the working tree; you still need add and commit to record history.

items.prompt: A good first practice trio for this module is…
choices: git push, git pull, git rebase
git status, git add, git commit
items.explain: The mental-model flow is see status → stage with add → record with commit.
